title: Gregory of Nyssa, Against Eunomius (2)
english: Another treatise of the same Gregory of Nyssa, on the same subject, has been read by me, in which, grappling with Eunomius chiefly by logic, he utterly confutes him, rotting away every stronghold of his impiety. The beauty of his discourse, and its well-tempered brilliance, shine out with sweetness in his case too.
translator_notes: Greek locked from Bekker 1824; Freese 1920 used as PD English reference only.
Codex 7 of 279; Second treatise of Gregory of Nyssa against Eunomius; more logical/refutation-focused than the first.
